recipes.allocate: Native candidate.map flag; return current counter and cached allocated core; flag function preserves old flags unless flag is true and slot equals fresh counter. Waiting unchanged. Core allocated inherits ancestry once.
recipes.writeSlot: Raw optional slot lookup.bind old, then NativeIndex.write with references value as gained and references old as lost. No representative resolution of target, no ancestry update.
recipes.prepareOrdinary: Match only ordinary node. Reject terminal-scs bucket; encode.bind handle; allocate.bind allocation pair; writeSlot full scs at allocation.1 and allocation.2; map after to (.hole allocation.1,after). Other value shapes return none.
